title: swelter
description: A community-owned network of low-cost heat and air-quality sensors with the pipeline, calibration, and accessible map that make its readings trustworthy and reusable. Nodes measure temperature, humidity, PM2.5/PM10, optional NO2, and derived heat metrics; a time-series pipeline ingests the readings, QC-flags the bad ones, calibrates each node's drift against reference monitors, and maps urban heat and AQI at neighborhood resolution through a framework-free WCAG 2.2 AA-targeting dashboard. First-party community observations and synthetic fixtures are CC0-1.0; fetched third-party observations retain their source-specific license and attribution, including a per-location ledger for OpenAQ. Exports use CSV, JSON, a read-only OGC SensorThings subset, and a Datasette-openable SQLite store. Privacy invariants are merge-blocking: no field can identify a person, public coordinates snap to a coarse grid, and calibrated and raw readings are never silently mixed.
